title: Selected Duas
blurb: Duas from the Quran and Sunnah

items.title: Dua Seeking Good In This World And In The Hereafter
items.ar: رَبَّنَا آَتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآَخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.tr: rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
items.en: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and give us good in the Hereafter, and save us from the torment of the hell fire.

items.title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #1
items.ar: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِى عَلَى دِينِكَ
items.en: O Changer of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

items.title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #2
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
items.en: O Allah! Controller of the hearts, direct our hearts to Your obedience.

items.title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #3
items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
items.tr: rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana
items.en: O our Lord, do not make our hearts incline to error after You have guided us.

items.title: Dua To Seek Refuge Against The Loss Of Pleasure
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
items.tr: allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matik, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatik, wa fuja'ati niqmatik, wa jami'i sakhatik
items.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the loss of the pleasures that You have bestowed, from changes in the health that You have bestowed, from Your sudden torment, and from all Your wrath.

items.title: Dua To Resist Affliction
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ البَلاَءِ ، وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ ، وَسُوءِ القَضَاءِ ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاء
items.tr: allahumma inni a'udhu bika min jahdil-bala', wa darakish-shaqa', wa su'il-qada', wa shamatatil-a'da'
items.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from severe calamity, being overtaken by misery, evil destiny, and the triumphant mockery of enemies.

items.title: Dua To Be Released From Debt, Anxiety, Weakness, Laziness, Fear, And Pressure from Others
items.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزْنِ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَتِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرجال
items.tr: allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-huzni wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhli wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal
items.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from care and grief, I seek refuge in You from incapacity and slackness, I seek refuge in You from cowardice and niggardliness, and I seek refuge in You from being overcome by debt and being put in subjection by men.

items.title: Dua When Getting Good News
items.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
items.tr: alhamdu lillahi alladhi bini'matihi tattimmu assalihat
items.en: Praise be to Allah, by whose grace goodness is perfected.
items.citedAs: HR. Ibn Majah in the Sunan, No. 3803 and al-Hakim in al-Mustadrak (1/499)
